tests_v3.name: 领域无桌面启动

tests_v3.assertion: 原工作副本保留；旧结果不能采用；终态说明拒绝原因

tests_v3.name: 身份代际与类型校验

tests_v3.assertion: 返回失效/类型错误；不访问新对象，不靠同一整数推断相同身份
tests_v3.p01_scope: History/session/affected old-product coverage only; later model/workflow and P13 qualification gates still require their own evidence.

tests_v3.name: 撤销回保存点
tests_v3.arrange: 保存 S10、编辑 S11、undo 到 S10
tests_v3.assertion: 本绑定基线仍 S10；当前恢复 clean；通知版本可继续增长
tests_v3.p01_scope: History/session/affected old-product coverage only; later model/workflow and P13 qualification gates still require their own evidence.

tests_v3.name: 字节相同不伪造状态等价

tests_v3.assertion: 按文档保守定义仍 dirty；不能混用内容 hash/通知版本清除标记

tests_v3.p01_scope: History/session/affected old-product coverage only; later model/workflow and P13 qualification gates still require their own evidence.

tests_v3.name: 编辑准备故障

tests_v3.assertion: 作者内容、历史游标和可观察选择不发生半提交
tests_v3.evidence: P01 scoped result: X01-01/X01-05: prepare rejection, preparation budget exhaustion and failed live reload adoption
tests_v3.p01_scope: History/session/affected old-product coverage only; later model/workflow and P13 qualification gates still require their own evidence.

tests_v3.name: 编辑门和许可语义
tests_v3.arrange: 编译期复制 EditScope；嵌套进入编辑；移动/释放 ClosePermit
tests_v3.assertion: EditScope 不可复制/移动；重入被拒；permit 未消费只解除限制
tests_v3.p01_scope: History/session/affected old-product coverage only; later model/workflow and P13 qualification gates still require their own evidence.

tests_v3.name: 冻结快照与后台寿命
tests_v3.arrange: 捕获后继续编辑/关闭视图，延迟编码和完成采用
tests_v3.assertion: 编码对应捕获状态；无 live Session/Pane 裸指针跨任务；所有输出显式拥有

tests_v3.name: 保存旧状态时继续编辑
tests_v3.arrange: 捕获 S10 后编辑到 S12，再完成保存

tests_v3.name: 反序编码、有序发布
tests_v3.arrange: W2 编码先完成；W1 延迟/失败/取消；最后再保存撤销后的旧 StateId
tests_v3.assertion: 同目标按准入发布；空洞可终结；最后意图决定最终文件，不按 StateId.serial 排序

tests_v3.name: 两个副本同目标冲突

tests_v3.assertion: 后一写入按后端契约报告冲突，不能静默串接成同一工作副本的后继

tests_v3.name: Save As 冻结与普通 Save
tests_v3.arrange: 分别在正常 Save 和 Save As 飞行期间编辑、重载及再次保存
tests_v3.assertion: 正常 Save 允许编辑；Save As 按 permit 拒绝冲突操作，结束准确释放

tests_v3.name: 提交后取消与记录清理
tests_v3.arrange: 后端已发布，随后 cancel 或 acknowledge
tests_v3.assertion: 结果为已提交/取消过晚；acknowledge 不撤销文件、不清除未完成资源责任

tests_v3.name: 关闭与迟到保存结果
tests_v3.arrange: 处理关闭期间保存；删除 Session 后注入已允许保留任务的完成
tests_v3.assertion: 无 UAF；已发布事实保留，不能采用到重用槽位；新绑定不被旧回执污染

tests_v3.name: 全体关闭后项取消
tests_v3.arrange: A 已保存，B 选择取消；或第二个 permit 失败
tests_v3.assertion: 任何 Session 均未被提前销毁；A 的真实保存保留并报告；permit 全部释放

tests_v3.name: 审阅戳过期

tests_v3.assertion: 不能丢弃未经审阅的 S12；重新审阅或明确拒绝

tests_v3.name: 最后视图策略

tests_v3.name: 运行隔离
tests_v3.arrange: 从 S10 启动 R；编辑作者源到 S12；运行中改变对象

tests_v3.name: 暂停仍维护

tests_v3.name: 步进回执

tests_v3.name: 选择身份隔离
